from pathlib import Path
import math
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFilter
import artifact_io

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
W,H=256,192
S=4
source=Image.open(ROOT/'first_frame.png').convert('RGB')
a=np.asarray(source).astype(np.float32)
# The object's matte is measured from its saturated red paint in the supplied image.
red=((a[:,:,0]-a[:,:,1]>45)&(a[:,:,0]-a[:,:,2]>45)&(a[:,:,0]>95))
matte=Image.fromarray((red*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(3)).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.5))
remove=Image.fromarray((red*255).astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.MaxFilter(7))
hole=np.asarray(remove)>0
# Harmonic continuation of the tabletop, using only its adjacent source pixels.
clean=a.copy()
for c in range(3): clean[:,:,c][hole]=np.mean(a[:,:,c][~hole & (np.indices(hole.shape)[0]<100)])
for _ in range(1700):
    avg=(np.roll(clean,1,0)+np.roll(clean,-1,0)+np.roll(clean,1,1)+np.roll(clean,-1,1))*.25
    clean[hole]=avg[hole]
# Restore the very low amplitude surface grain in the filled patch.
noise=a[:,90:180]-np.asarray(Image.fromarray(a[:,90:180].astype('uint8')).filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(2))).astype(float)
for y,x in zip(*np.where(hole)):
    clean[y,x]+=noise[y,(x+11)%90]*.45
clean=np.uint8(np.clip(clean,0,255))
background=Image.fromarray(clean)
obj=source.copy().convert('RGBA'); obj.putalpha(matte)

# Small raster geometry helpers. Everything is drawn supersampled and camera-fixed.
def polygon(draw,pts,fill): draw.polygon([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in pts],fill=fill)
def line(draw,pts,fill,width): draw.line([(round(x*S),round(y*S)) for x,y in pts], fill=fill,width=max(1,round(width*S)))
def ellipse(draw,box,fill,outline=None,width=1):
    draw.ellipse(tuple(round(v*S) for v in box),fill=fill,outline=outline,width=max(1,round(width*S)))
def coords(p,u,v,x,y): return (p[0]+x*u[0]+y*v[0],p[1]+x*u[1]+y*v[1])
def add(p,q): return (p[0]+q[0],p[1]+q[1])
def joint(d,p,r,angle=0):
    x,y=p
    ellipse(d,(x-r,y-r+1.5,x+r,y+r+1.5),(31,34,38,255))
    ellipse(d,(x-r,y-r,x+r,y+r),(83,89,94,255))
    ellipse(d,(x-r+.9,y-r+.6,x+r-.9,y+r-1),(161,168,172,255))
    ellipse(d,(x-r+2.2,y-r+2.2,x+r-2.2,y+r-2.2),(54,60,65,255))
    ellipse(d,(x-r*.42,y-r*.42,x+r*.42,y+r*.42),(125,134,140,255))
    ellipse(d,(x-r*.29,y-r*.31,x+r*.22,y+r*.19),(189,197,202,255))
    for i in range(4):
        t=angle+i*math.pi/2
        bx=x+math.cos(t)*r*.73; by=y+math.sin(t)*r*.73
        ellipse(d,(bx-.72,by-.72,bx+.72,by+.72),(38,43,48,255))

def link(d,p,q,width):
    dx=q[0]-p[0];dy=q[1]-p[1];le=math.hypot(dx,dy);u=(dx/le,dy/le);v=(-u[1],u[0]);r=width/2
    shape=[(2,-r*.6),(8,-r),(le-9,-r),(le-2,-r*.5),(le-2,r*.5),(le-9,r),(8,r),(2,r*.6)]
    polygon(d,[add(coords(p,u,v,x,y),(0,2.1)) for x,y in shape],(41,46,51,255))
    polygon(d,[coords(p,u,v,x,y) for x,y in shape],(130,140,148,255))
    # Machined metal cross-section; fixed edge strips rotate with each rigid link.
    for y1,y2,col in [(-r,-r+1.4,(205,213,218,255)),(-r+1.4,-1,(164,174,180,255)),(-1,2,(136,148,158,255)),(2,r,(93,104,113,255))]:
        polygon(d,[coords(p,u,v,9,y1),coords(p,u,v,le-10,y1),coords(p,u,v,le-10,y2),coords(p,u,v,9,y2)],col)
    line(d,[coords(p,u,v,19,1.8),coords(p,u,v,le-20,1.8)],(74,85,96,255),1)
    # A dark cable along the protected lower edge.
    line(d,[coords(p,u,v,13,r+.6),coords(p,u,v,le-15,r+.6)],(32,38,44,255),2)

BASE=(325.,65.); L1=150.;L2=150.
def elbow(wrist):
    dx=wrist[0]-BASE[0];dy=wrist[1]-BASE[1];r=math.hypot(dx,dy)
    z=(L1*L1-L2*L2+r*r)/(2*r); h=math.sqrt(max(0,L1*L1-z*z))
    # The elbow-up solution has identical link lengths at every time step.
    return (BASE[0]+z*dx/r-h*dy/r, BASE[1]+z*dy/r+h*dx/r)

# Fixed gripper orientation aligns its pads with the two long, opposite block faces.
U=(.962,-.273); V=(.273,.962)
def gripper(d,p,gap,scale):
    def P(x,y):return coords(p,U,V,x*scale,y*scale)
    def poly(points,c):polygon(d,[P(x,y) for x,y in points],c)
    # Wrist servo and its flange remain rigid while the fingers slide on their guide.
    poly([(-7,-15),(7,-15),(9,-4),(-9,-4)],(45,52,59,255))
    poly([(-6,-15),(-1,-15),(-1,-4),(-8,-4)],(154,166,175,255))
    poly([(-21,-5),(21,-5),(21,5),(-21,5)],(46,53,60,255))
    poly([(-21,-6),(21,-6),(19,-2),(-19,-2)],(201,211,218,255))
    poly([(-19,-2),(19,-2),(19,3),(-19,3)],(121,135,146,255))
    line(d,[P(-18,1),P(18,1)],(31,39,47,255),1.4*scale)
    # Opposed, parallel, rigid fingers: only their lateral separation changes.
    for side in [-1,1]:
        cx=side*gap/2
        poly([(cx-3,-2),(cx+3,-2),(cx+3,24),(cx-3,24)],(67,77,85,255))
        poly([(cx-2.8,-2),(cx-1,-2),(cx-1,23),(cx-2.8,23)],(190,202,210,255))
        poly([(cx-1,-1),(cx+2,-1),(cx+2,22),(cx-1,23)],(134,148,158,255))
        ix=cx-side*2.5
        poly([(ix-side*1,15),(ix+side*1,15),(ix+side*1,24),(ix-side*1,24)],(24,30,35,255))
        q=P(cx,2);ellipse(d,(q[0]-1.0*scale,q[1]-1.0*scale,q[0]+1.0*scale,q[1]+1.0*scale),(37,45,52,255))
    # Small inset on the housing, rather than a moving or glowing decoration.
    poly([(-5,-5),(5,-5),(5,-2),(-5,-2)],(37,45,51,255))

def rigid_object(scale,foot):
    # Perspective depth produces uniform scale, never shearing or bending the block.
    tx=foot[0]-64*scale;ty=foot[1]-84*scale
    return obj.transform((W,H),Image.Transform.AFFINE,(1/scale,0,-tx/scale,0,1/scale,-ty/scale),Image.Resampling.BICUBIC)

def render(i):
    if i==0:return np.asarray(source).copy()
    t=0.;lift=0.
    if 7<=i<=8:lift=(i-6)*5.5
    if 9<=i<=13:
        t={9:.14,10:.36,11:.62,12:.86,13:1.}[i];lift=11.
    if i>=14:t=1.;lift=5.5 if i==14 else 0.
    scale=1-.18*t
    foot=(64+110*t,84-31*t-lift)
    grip=(foot[0]+(55-64)*scale,foot[1]+(39-84)*scale)
    if i<=4:
        wrist={1:(274,-32),2:(197,6),3:(119,26),4:(55,39)}[i];gap=42.
    elif i==5:wrist=grip;gap=34.
    elif i<=15:wrist=grip;gap=28.
    elif i==16:wrist=grip;gap=39.
    elif i==17:wrist=(grip[0]+14,grip[1]-19);gap=42.
    elif i==18:wrist=(224,-33);gap=42.
    else:wrist=(283,-100);gap=42.
    e=elbow(wrist)
    frame=(source if i<=6 else background).convert('RGBA')
    # Table contact and gently diffused cast shadow track the object's true support.
    if i>=7:
        sh=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));sd=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
        fx,fy=foot
        blur=2.3+lift*.12
        ellipse(sd,((fx-13*scale+lift*.3),(fy-2+lift*.35),(fx+18*scale+lift*.3),(fy+8+lift*.35)),(10,13,18,int(42-lift*.8)))
        sh=sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(blur*S)).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,sh)
        frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,rigid_object(scale,foot))
    # A soft, weak arm shadow lies on the table, independently of the hard mechanism.
    sh=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));sd=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
    line(sd,[(BASE[0]+5,BASE[1]+15),(e[0]+5,e[1]+15),(wrist[0]+5,wrist[1]+15)],(13,20,24,19),13)
    sh=sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(4*S)).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,sh)
    arm=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));d=ImageDraw.Draw(arm)
    link(d,BASE,e,17);link(d,e,wrist,12)
    joint(d,e,9.5,math.atan2(wrist[1]-e[1],wrist[0]-e[0]))
    joint(d,wrist,7.1*scale,0)
    gripper(d,wrist,gap,scale)
    arm=arm.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    # Slight optical softness matches the original low-resolution camera.
    arm=arm.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.28))
    frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,arm)
    return np.asarray(frame.convert('RGB'))

frames=np.stack([render(i) for i in range(20)]).astype(np.uint8)
assert np.array_equal(frames[0],np.asarray(source))
artifact_io.save(frames,ROOT)
print('Saved 20 RGB frames and the video player to',ROOT)

def save(frames, case_dir, audio=None):
    case_dir = Path(case_dir)
    frames = np.asarray(frames)
    path = case_dir / "task_spec.json"
    spec = json.loads(path.read_text()) if path.is_file() else {}
    n, h, w, fps = (spec.get("frames", 20), spec.get("height", 144), spec.get("width", 256), spec.get("fps", 4))
    assert frames.shape == (n, h, w, 3) and frames.dtype == np.uint8, frames.shape
    audio_spec = spec.get("audio")
    audio_url = None
    if audio_spec:
        samples = round(n / fps * audio_spec["sample_rate"])
        pcm = np.asarray(audio)
        if pcm.ndim == 1:
            pcm = pcm[:, None]
        assert pcm.shape == (samples, audio_spec["channels"]) and pcm.dtype == np.int16, (pcm.shape, pcm.dtype)
        with wave.open(str(case_dir / "audio.wav"), "wb") as handle:
            handle.setnchannels(audio_spec["channels"])
            handle.setsampwidth(2)
            handle.setframerate(audio_spec["sample_rate"])
            handle.writeframes(pcm.astype("<i2").tobytes())
        audio_url = "data:audio/wav;base64," + base64.b64encode((case_dir / "audio.wav").read_bytes()).decode()
    values = frames.astype(np.uint32)
    packed = (values[:, :, :, 0] << 16) | (values[:, :, :, 1] << 8) | values[:, :, :, 2]
    tensor = packed.transpose(1, 2, 0)
    np.savez_compressed(case_dir / "pixels.npz", pixels=tensor)

    folder = case_dir / "frames"
    folder.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    for index, frame in enumerate(frames):
        Image.fromarray(frame).save(folder / f"{index:02d}.png")

    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, (h + 21) * 2), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(np.linspace(0, n - 1, 8).round().astype(int)):
        x, y = (index % 4) * w, (index // 4) * (h + 21)
        draw.text((x + 5, y + 3), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        sheet.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, y + 21))
    sheet.save(case_dir / "inspection.png")

    transition = Image.new("RGB", (w * 4, h * 2 + 21), (25, 28, 35))
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(transition)
    for index, frame_index in enumerate(min(i, n-1) for i in range(4)):
        x = index * w
        draw.text((x + 5, 4), f"frame {frame_index:02d} · {frame_index / fps:.2f}s", fill="white")
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]), (x, 21))
        transition.paste(Image.fromarray(frames[frame_index]).resize((w, h), Image.Resampling.NEAREST), (x, h + 21))
    transition.save(case_dir / "transition_check.png")

    encode = lambda array: base64.b64encode(np.asarray(array, dtype="<u4").tobytes()).decode()
    deltas = []
    for index in range(1, n):
        current = packed[index].reshape(-1)
        previous = packed[index - 1].reshape(-1)
        positions = np.flatnonzero(current != previous)
        packet = []
        if len(positions):
            bounds = np.r_[0, np.flatnonzero(np.diff(positions) > 1) + 1, len(positions)]
            for start, end in zip(bounds[:-1], bounds[1:]):
                offset = int(positions[start])
                count = int(end - start)
                packet.extend([offset, count])
                packet.extend(current[offset:offset + count].tolist())
        deltas.append(encode(packet))
    data = {
        "id": case_dir.name,
        "width": w, "height": h, "frames": n, "fps": fps, "audio": audio_url,
        "first": encode(packed[0].reshape(-1)),
        "deltas": deltas,
        "caption": (case_dir / "prompt.txt").read_text().strip(),
    }
    template = (Path(__file__).parent / "player_template.html").read_text()
    payload = json.dumps(data, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False).replace("<", "\\u003c")
    (case_dir / "index.html").write_text(template.replace("__ID__", case_dir.name).replace("__DATA__", payload))

    elif i==17:wrist=(grip[0]+14,grip[1]-19);gap=42.
    elif i==18:wrist=(224,-33);gap=42.
    else:wrist=(283,-100);gap=42.
    e=elbow(wrist)
    frame=(source if i<=6 else background).convert('RGBA')
    # Table contact and gently diffused cast shadow track the object's true support.
    if i>=7:
        sh=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));sd=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
        fx,fy=foot
        blur=2.3+lift*.12
        ellipse(sd,((fx-13*scale+lift*.3),(fy-2+lift*.35),(fx+18*scale+lift*.3),(fy+8+lift*.35)),(10,13,18,int(42-lift*.8)))
        sh=sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(blur*S)).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
        frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,sh)
        frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,rigid_object(scale,foot))
    # A soft, weak arm shadow lies on the table, independently of the hard mechanism.
    sh=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));sd=ImageDraw.Draw(sh)
    line(sd,[(BASE[0]+5,BASE[1]+15),(e[0]+5,e[1]+15),(wrist[0]+5,wrist[1]+15)],(13,20,24,19),13)
    sh=sh.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(4*S)).resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,sh)
    arm=Image.new('RGBA',(W*S,H*S));d=ImageDraw.Draw(arm)
    link(d,BASE,e,17);link(d,e,wrist,12)
    joint(d,e,9.5,math.atan2(wrist[1]-e[1],wrist[0]-e[0]))
    joint(d,wrist,7.1*scale,0)
    gripper(d,wrist,gap,scale)
    arm=arm.resize((W,H),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    # Slight optical softness matches the original low-resolution camera.
    arm=arm.filter(ImageFilter.GaussianBlur(.28))
    frame=Image.alpha_composite(frame,arm)
    return np.asarray(frame.convert('RGB'))

frames=np.stack([render(i) for i in range(20)]).astype(np.uint8)
